items.text: STOP WAITING TO FEEL READY. *START*, AND READINESS WILL FOLLOW.
items.author: MS. DEEPLY

items.text: DON'T COMPARE YOUR *BEGINNING* TO SOMEONE ELSE'S MIDDLE.
items.author: JON ACUFF

items.text: STOP SAYING YES TO EVERYTHING. EVERY YES IS A *NO* TO SOMETHING ELSE.
items.author: MS. DEEPLY

cta.text: SAVE THIS FOR THE DAY YOU *NEED* IT.
